steps.speaker: Monster
steps.content: Offer your fear... Offer your fear...!

steps.speaker: Monster
steps.content: Roar!!! Roar!!!
Two huge monsters keep roaring and hammering with their fists, almost breaking the entire hall to pieces.
The Mania outburst is spreading rapidly, and the whole museum is like a nucleus of fear about to fracture and explode.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The Witching Hour is expanding. It has absorbed thousands of guests and is still feeding on their fear...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Wait... They are moving upwards. Where are they going?
New monsters keep coming out of the dark mist and spreading upward. The outline of the building has disappeared, and the Mania pushes against an invisible barrier at the top...

options: ...They want to get out of here?

steps.content: The fear here is no longer enough for Sosia. She wants her "art" to be grander.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: They want to get out?! To break through the anti-Mania blockade outside and spread Witching Hour to the city?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: There are millions of people in Eastside. If fear starts spreading among them, the whole city will...
But how? The person who could destroy Sosia is no more, and you have lost your best chance of stopping the mutation.
At least, you can stabilize the Sinners' minds. If they can overcome their fear, they can fight against Sosia.
You try to concentrate and gather your power together, but a ghostly laugh comes from the glistening mist behind you.
Hehe... Hehe...
The laughter slowly approaches, coming from all directions and wrapping around you. The shackles that have just taken shape tremble slightly and then dissipate as if they have been drawn away.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Tsk, stop thinking so much!! Isn't there enough trouble in front of us?! I...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ${PlayerName}! Look behind you! Behind! Behind you!
It's not Sosia herself that emerges from the mist, but two fear monsters of unprecedented size!

steps.speaker: Fear Materialized
steps.content: Offer your fear... Offer your fear...!

steps.speaker: Fear Materialized
steps.content: Roar!!! Roar!!!
The monster's shackles are close at hand, and an arrow shoots right into it just then!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Ahaha, haha... Of course, I am the Archer Queen of Syndicate, I...

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: I'm giving up bragging... I can't hold this much longer!! Chief, help!!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What took you guys so long?! Wait, what's that thing... behind you?!
EMP and Lisa, who stayed behind, catch up with you. But an even more gigantic monster trails behind them, rushing all the way to where you are with the stairs.
The monster looks rather peculiar, with two scythes in the left hand, a leather whip in the right hand, and a strange flower in its mouth. EMP's howling even adds some comedic effect to it.

steps.speaker: Giant Monster
steps.content: Stop running... Stop running... EMP...!!!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Are you here to help or to cause more trouble? Don't come any closer! Don't run toward me!!!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: There's nothing I can do...!!
At the same time, white light slashes through the air, splitting the monster apart. A girl smashes down with the rubble and lands heavily on the ground.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Labyrinth?!
Cold blades extend from her ceramic arms, and lights flash through the girl's eyes.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Cleaning order, activated.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: EMP, Lisa, Hella, Hecate, why are you dazing? Return to battle right now. We need to protect Master.
